posts.title: So, What Do You Do?
posts.description: AI is rearranging the roles we've been defined by. Who would you be if money weren't tied to a role you had to do? What would you build?

posts.title: The Jacket Stayed On
posts.description: When life takes a jacket off you, the friction may be pointing at the next one. Try it on with enough structure that you don't feel lost.

posts.title: Once You Know the Scales
posts.description: A brand that feels like you starts underneath the look. Once the bones carry the business, the artist in you gets to come back to the front.
